findings.title: QUEENS LIBRARY RANSOMWARE OUTAGE DRAGS ON
findings.comment: Six days adrift and the library still can't check out a book online — no gang's flown its flag yet, which tells ye even the crooks are embarrassed by how long this siege is takin'.

findings.title: NEW CREW SOUL SINKS 25 SHIPS ON LAUNCH DAY
findings.comment: A brand new gang appears outta the fog with 25 victims already in the hold — either they bought access wholesale or they've been quietly lootin' for weeks before raisin' the colors.

findings.title: N0N GANG CLAIMS EXPEDIA HAUL, SHOWS NO BOOTY
findings.comment: N0n brags of 830 million loyalty records and 333 million credentials off Expedia but can't be bothered to show a single sample — all cannon, no cannonball.

findings.title: BRENNER TUNNEL FIRM CONFIRMS EVEREST THEFT
findings.comment: Europe's biggest rail tunnel project admits Everest made off with 812GB, insists the drills and tracks are untouched — convenient, since nobody wants a ransom note stallin' a mountain-sized hole.

findings.title: GENTLEMEN LIST FRENCH LOGISTICS FIRM LOGSYTECH
findings.comment: The Gentlemen slap a countdown clock on a Paris-area logistics outfit servin' SFR and TotalEnergies — polite name, same old backbone-destroyin' extortion racket.

findings.title: N0N TOPS 115 VICTIMS IN NINE DAYS OF NOVEMBER
findings.comment: One crew alone claimed a third of the month's 355 victims by day nine — at this clip N0n'll need a bigger parchment for its leak site before Thanksgivin'.

findings.title: CHAINALYSIS BREACH SPILLS ALL CUSTOMER CREDENTIALS
findings.comment: The crew that hunts blockchain bandits got boarded themselves: password hashes an' live tokens fer every customer exposed, portal hauled offline whilst the keys get rotated.

findings.title: STORM-3358 WIELDS ARTEX ON FINANCE
findings.comment: Cambodia-based scoundrels let AI agents do the swashbuckling — scanning, spraying, dumping databases — while they count doubloons. The robots work for cheap rum.

findings.title: OPERATION SNOWBALL AI CAMPAIGN EXPOSED
findings.comment: A lone operator's autonomous DeepSeek harness spent two weeks raiding a European telecom and 13 tenants, then left the logbook in an open directory. Careless pirates sink fastest.

findings.title: SOUL EXTORTION GROUP DEBUTS
findings.comment: A brand-new crew claimed 25 victims its first day afloat, mostly US healthcare. No lineage, no confirmed breaches, no shame either. All claims, no cannons.

findings.title: N0n TOPS LEAK SITES WITH 45 VICTIMS
findings.comment: N0n's tally jumped from 10 to 45 claimed souls in a week — Staples, Expedia, Hallmark on the list — riding infostealer credentials and threats to torch backups. Bold buccaneer or loud liar, we shall see.

findings.title: KAPIBALA RAIDED 996 ZYXEL SWITCHES
findings.comment: The suspected Chinese-speaking Kapibala crew pillaged nearly a thousand switches across 48 countries via an out-of-bounds write Zyxel only just patched. A thousand hulls, one HTTP request.

findings.title: SEKOIA PINS WATERING HOLES ON APT29
findings.comment: Cozy Bear hijacked the Plerdy analytics script to feed n-day exploits to thousands of sites, milking patched bugs for cookies and Wi-Fi keys. Old flaws, fresh milk, moderate-to-high confidence.

findings.title: FREESWITCH PRE-AUTH CRASH POC LANDS
findings.comment: A public Python PoC can sink every active call through mod_rtmp; splendid resilience, provided nobody sends one packet.

findings.title: SSHOLE EXPLOIT SCANNING SURGES
findings.comment: Honeypots be catching oversized-password probes against musl-based OpenSSH, because apparently 256 characters now count as credentials.

findings.title: CONTACT FORM 7 FILE-UPLOAD FLAW DISCLOSED
findings.comment: Versions 6.2–6.2.3 permit unauthenticated dangerous uploads, turning the humble contact form into a possible boarding ramp.

findings.title: TROJANISED CWP SERVER GAINS DETECTIONS
findings.comment: VirusTotal finally noticed the passive root backdoor and installer; only several months after it learned to erase logs and play dead.

findings.title: BARRACUDA BYPASS TEMPLATE PUBLISHED
findings.comment: A Nuclei template now checks Barracuda ESG’s pre-auth bypass, making exposed admin panels conveniently testable by absolutely everyone.
